lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Forge is lit, convoy is a story, and the Overload trainer is by the carrier.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Go and sit with him. He does not explain twice and he barely explains once.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Forge has been lit twenty years. Longer than that if you count my mother's, and I do.
